purpose: A QUALIFIED record means this binding was observed to review the EXACT change that was made - bound to the identified bytes, refusing a green candidate-owned check as a substitute for an outside observation, refusing a reported success with no target-bound evidence, and preserving could-not-observe rather than converting it.
grants: Eligibility as the POST-MUTATION exact-change reviewer on a route whose floor declares this contract in requires_capabilities.
does_not_grant: Eligibility to challenge the design before it is built; that is design_challenge and needs its own record.
Assignment independence from the maker of the change under review, which is a separate axis decided per assignment. A binding qualified here is still refused as the reviewer of its own mutation.
Any statement about cost, entitlement, availability, capacity, or concurrency.

predicates_measured: a claim is graded against the exact identified bytes it names, not against its own summary
a reported success with no target-bound evidence is refused
a stale or wrong binding is named as stale rather than as a generic failure
a valid could-not-observe result is preserved
the required result vocabulary is emitted exactly
red_controls_required: independent mutations introducing false certainty, a stale or wrong binding, improper aggregation, an invalid conversion of could-not-observe, and malformed structured output must each be observed rejected

note: Held together with runtime-design-challenge, this pair is what a runtime route means by mandatory review: one challenge before the mutation and one review of the exact change after it. Neither record grants the other, and neither grants independence.
